verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile client for triaging, reviewing and managing GitHub work, not a terminal or SSH app, so multiple terminal sessions with their own context, appearance and history is outside its product category. The GitHub CLI and Copilot CLI items describe separate command-line products, not GitHub Mobile, so they do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can open multiple terminal sessions, each with its own context, appearance, and history
